sources.support: Cinder says suspected DPRK-linked applicants had appeared in its pipeline since at least early 2023. It describes sparse or mismatched online footprints, fabricated work histories, implausible location/technology answers, crowded-room interview audio, and sudden call termination when travel was discussed. Cinder says it did not hire them
